goal: Stop persisting a Dialog and kip_agent_session the instant a board mounts. Create both lazily, on the first real message a user actually sends, across every board preset that shares the resumeOrCreateBoardSession / findOrCreateKipDialog path.
done_when: Visiting any board (ide, agent, domain, realm, designer) and sending zero messages creates zero new Dialog rows and zero new kip_agent_session rows -- confirmed by direct query before/after, not assumed
Sending the first real message in a fresh board still creates exactly one Dialog + one kip_agent_session, same as today's behavior, just deferred to send-time instead of mount-time
Revisiting a board that already has an active session still resumes it correctly via the existing read-only resolveActiveDialogSessions path -- unchanged

The four call sites that currently trigger eager creation are all covered: UniversalConversation.tsx's IDE effect (~line 1720), UniversalConversation.tsx's Designer effect (~line 1774), useAgentDialog.ts's Agent/Domain/Realm path (~lines 482-551), and useAgentDialog.ts's parallel IDE path (~lines 553-620) -- confirm whether that last one is genuinely dead code or a second live call site, and handle accordingly
pnpm run quick:web and pnpm run quick:api pass

Manual check: open the IDE board fresh (no prior session), confirm no new Dialog appears in Realm's Nav 'Dialogs' group until a message is actually sent; then send one message and confirm exactly one Dialog appears

do_not_touch: resolveActiveDialogSessions / GET /kip/dialogs/resolve/active -- this read-only resolution path is correct as-is, do not change its semantics
DialogCastMember / cast-membership work -- shipped separately, unrelated
Real per-agent delegation (Phase 2, director-lead-initiated-delegation) -- still not in scope

pattern_ref: This is a timing fix, not a new pattern: move the existing findOrCreateKipDialog + session-create call from the board-mount effect to the sendMessage callback (useAgentDialog.ts's sendMessage, ~line 649), gated on 'no active session yet' the same way it's gated today -- just triggered by the user's first send instead of the effect's mount.

git.pr_title: fix: create Dialog + session lazily on first message, not on board mount

context.phase: Follow-on to cross-domain-cast-membership (archived, shipped 2026-07-22). Chuck observed live that visiting the IDE board alone created a persisted, empty 'Ide · conversation · Jul 23' Dialog that then polluted Realm's Nav.
context.notes: First of three follow-on handoffs from today's live testing (see chronicle-document-architecture.md, 2026-07-22 section, for the full punch list and priority order Chuck asked for). This one is first because it's the most bounded and mechanical, and because it stops ongoing data pollution -- every board visit until this ships keeps writing another empty Dialog. A related Nav-side symptom (the same dialog's name rendering twice -- once in the new 'Dialogs' group, once again as its own '0 items' stage-group card) was fixed directly by Cloud in RealmStagedNav.tsx (skip a per-dialog stage section entirely when it has zero items in every stage), not scoped to Cursor -- small, well-understood, no architectural judgment call involved.
